# new-idea

Kind: non-Git idea workspace.
The built workspace contains only `brief.md`.
The seed is a new project without a repo or history, with explicit goals, vocabulary and an approved stack.
It has no unresolved stack decision.
Serves AC-1 and AC-9 as input for the later intent interview.
`node sanity.mjs <built-folder>` requires Node 24 or later and checks the brief and absence of Git.
